citations.excerpt: The second-largest Lutheran denomination in the United States was founded in Missouri by German immigrants in 1847.

facts.value: A U.S. Lutheran church founded by immigrants, many of whom had rejected the planned merger of Lutheran and Reformed churches in Prussia.
